newsitem.title: HUNGARY: CHINESE RESTAURANT SET ON FIRE IN HUNGARIAN CITY.
newsitem.headline: CHINESE RESTAURANT SET ON FIRE IN HUNGARIAN CITY.

text.p: A Chinese restaurant was burned down Saturday night in the southern Hungarian city Szeged, the national news agency MTI said on Sunday.
A Szeged police official told Reuters the police did not have proof for arson.
"But drinks and cigarettes are missing and perhaps the fire was in connection with a crime against property," said colonel Istvan Marton.
MTI said a flammable material was sprinkled and set on fire in the restaurant.
The Hungarian Radio earlier said that according to its unconfirmed information, revenge between the Chinese could be the motive of arson.
